stemBlocks: Dilute hydrochloric acid and magnesium were mixed and the total volume of gas released was measured over time.
What is the average rate of reaction, in g s$^{-1}$, with respect to the magnesium over the first two seconds?
($A_r$ value: Mg = 24. Assume that the volume of one mole of gas is 24 dm$^3$.)
